qualification_review.scope: the corrected bytes against the official PDF
qualification_review.not_established: rules authority, semantic acceptance, or any claim about a corpus built from these bytes

digest_basis: upstream_sha256 is the sha256 of the upstream Git blob at this commit (LF line endings) and never changes: it is the baseline every correction is a diff against. sha256 is the sha256 of the controlled bytes in this directory; it equals upstream_sha256 exactly when corrections is empty. docs/sources/community/dnd-5e-srd-markdown/** is marked -text in .gitattributes so checkout never rewrites these bytes on any platform.

files.excluded_because: upstream editor/build ignore patterns; a .gitignore inside this directory would silently affect what Afterworlds tracks here
upstream contribution process, not source content

corrections.section: Equipment > Adventuring Gear > Food, Drink, and Lodging table
corrections.change: Rebuilt the four-column table as the two-column 'Item | Cost' list the pages print, in page order, with 'Inn Stay per Day', 'Meal' and 'Wine (bottle)' as group rows.
corrections.why: The page sets one list in paired sub-columns that snake column-major across pp.101-102. corrections.section: Figurine of Wondrous Power > Ebony Fly > Giant Fly stat block
corrections.change: Set the block from '#### Giant Fly' to '##### Giant Fly' and moved it, unchanged, from between the Ebony Fly and Golden Lions paragraphs to the end of the Figurine entry, after Silver Raven and before '#### Flame Tongue'.
corrections.why: At the item's own depth the block ended the Figurine entry, so Flame Tongue and the items after it read as figurine material. Official p.222 sets the block beside the entry rather than after it, and the variants from Golden Lions to Silver Raven are the entry's own text; Markdown has no such inset, so depth alone cannot both nest the block where it stands and leave the variants with the figurine. Carrying the block to the end of the entry does both. Every line of prose is preserved, and the official page decides ownership.

corrections.section: Monsters A-Z > Young White Dragon > ability grid
corrections.change: INT saving throw cell '2' becomes '−2'.
corrections.why: OFFICIAL-SOURCE-BACKED CORRECTION, not publisher SRD text and not an Owner decision: proposed under the Owner-requested lookup (monsters-source-corrections-research.md), pending the Owner's exact acceptance. The official SRD 5.2.1 p.340 and its Basic Rules rendering (https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/creature-stat-blocks) print 'INT 6 -2 2'. The current official individual stat block (https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/5195287-young-white-dragon, Monster Manual p.328; same AC 17, HP 123, CR 6) prints the save as -2, matching its MOD. Errata checked first, on 2026-09-27: the D&D Beyond SRD page (https://www.dndbeyond.com/srd) lists no SRD 5.2/5.2.1 errata document, and the official Monster Manual (2025) errata v1.0 (https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/errata/MM-25/MM-2025_v1.pdf) has no Young White Dragon entry. No applicable formal erratum was found in those sources; that is not evidence that none exists, and none is claimed. The official sources disagree and that disagreement is recorded here.

corrections.section: Playing the Game > Exploration > Travel Pace > Travel Pace table
corrections.change: Rebuilt the header as the two rows the page prints: an empty cell over Pace beside 'Distance Traveled Per …' spanning three columns, then 'Pace | Minute | Hour | Day'. Removed the body row '| Minute | Hour | Day' that carried the second header row as data.
corrections.why: The conversion flattened a spanning two-row header into one header row plus a data row, so 'Distance Traveled Per …' sat over the Minute column only and the unit labels read as a pace named ''. No value moves; the column labels return to the columns they head.

corrections.section: Rules Glossary > Rules Definitions > Swim Speed
corrections.change: Promoted the heading to an h4, the rank every other entry in the run uses ('### Swim Speed' -> '#### Swim Speed').
corrections.why: Swim Speed was the only h3 among the 155 headings of the entry run, so under Markdown ownership it closed no h4 and instead captured every following entry until the next h2. Thirteen entries -- Target through Weapon Attack -- and their 47 units became its descendants. The official pages show them as peers: Swim Speed and Swimming print on p.189, Target and Telepathy on p.190, Unconscious and Weapon Attack on p.191, each as a glossary entry of the same rank. The defect family is the one family G records for stat blocks, a heading emitted at the wrong depth taking ownership of its siblings; family G's scan was per stat block and the glossary has none, which is why an entry-run rank outlier was outside what it could see. Post-dates the b70d016 qualification review and awaits independent review with it.

controlled_additions.why: CC-BY-4.0 requires the attribution statement to travel with any derived work. Official p.1 carries it and the upstream snapshot does not: upstream's own README and LICENSE are repository process and licence text, not the SRD's Legal Information page, and official p.1 is not the navigation-only table of contents on pp.2-4. Built from the text layer of p.1; it compacts identically to that page under policy.compact.
